evals.prompt: After our v17 upgrade, editors are complaining that the BlockList editor is doing weird double-render things — like the preview keeps flashing or sometimes the block content shows twice. BlockGrid editor is fine, only BlockList. Any idea what's up?
evals.expected_output: Identifies this as BlockPreview being enabled for BlockList — should be disabled in v17 because the v17 backoffice BlockList editor has its own preview behaviour that conflicts. Provides the appsettings.json fix (BlockPreview.BlockList.Enabled = false, while BlockPreview.BlockGrid stays enabled). Points to blocks-and-pickers.md.
expectations: Identifies the cause as BlockPreview being enabled for BlockList (conflicts with v17's built-in BlockList preview behaviour)
Provides the appsettings.json fix to disable BlockPreview for BlockList
States BlockGrid should remain enabled — only BlockList needs to be disabled
References blocks-and-pickers.md

evals.prompt: Editors are reporting that the YouTube embed feature in the rich text editor doesn't work since we upgraded to v17. They click the YouTube button, paste a URL, and nothing happens — browser console shows some kind of CSP / referrer error. RTE works fine for everything else.
evals.expected_output: Identifies this as the YouTube backoffice CSP/Referrer-Policy issue. The fix is in Program.cs — middleware that overrides Referrer-Policy to 'strict-origin-when-cross-origin' for any request path starting with /umbraco. Notes this is technically a backend fix (cross-references umbraco-13-to-17-backend's program-cs-v17.md) but acknowledges the editor-facing symptom belongs to this skill. Provides the middleware code snippet.
expectations: Identifies the cause as a Referrer-Policy issue affecting backoffice /umbraco routes
States the fix is in Program.cs — middleware overriding the Referrer-Policy header for /umbraco paths
Provides or describes the middleware code snippet for the Referrer-Policy override
Notes this is technically a backend change and cross-references umbraco-13-to-17-backend or program-cs-v17.md

evals.prompt: We have a Block Grid data type on the site with about 20 block configurations. Each one has a label like `{{ heading }}` or `{{ value | ncNodeName }}`. After the v17 upgrade those labels are showing the raw template syntax instead of values in the backoffice. What's the new format?
evals.expected_output: Identifies this as the AngularJS → UFM (Umbraco Flavored Markdown) template syntax change. Provides the mapping: `{{ heading }}` → `{=heading}` (short for `{umbValue: heading}`), `{{ value | ncNodeName }}` → `{umbContentName: value}`. Mentions this can be done either in the backoffice UI per data type OR by mass-editing the uSync data type config files (recommends the latter for 20 blocks). Notes the equivalent rewrite is needed in uSync nameTemplate fields, cross-references the database skill. Points to nametemplate-rewrite.md in the database skill.
expectations: Identifies this as the AngularJS to UFM (Umbraco Flavored Markdown) label template syntax change
Provides the mapping: {{ heading }} becomes {=heading} (or {umbValue: heading})
Provides the mapping: {{ value | ncNodeName }} becomes {umbContentName: value}
Mentions that mass-editing the uSync data type config files is an option (and preferable for 20 blocks)
References nametemplate-rewrite.md (in the database skill)

evals.prompt: Working through the v17 SCSS migration. I've imported blockpreview.scss from our v17 starter template. What else am I missing? The backoffice info partials look unstyled — they're showing in grey instead of our brand colour.
evals.expected_output: Identifies the issues to address: (1) backoffice info SCSS needs the colour values (not variable names) migrated from the v13 variables/_color.scss into the v17 backoffice info styles — that's why they're grey; if they stay grey, the SCSS isn't being included, so check the bundle config; (2) the compiled blockpreview.css must land at /css/blockpreview.css to match BlockPreview:BlockGrid:Stylesheet in appsettings.json; (3) add .stylelintcache to .gitignore. Points to scss-and-partials.md.
expectations: Identifies the grey backoffice info partials as needing brand colour values migrated from v13 SCSS variables into the v17 backoffice info styles
Mentions checking the bundle config if the backoffice info styles still aren't applied
Notes the compiled blockpreview.css must match the BlockPreview:BlockGrid:Stylesheet path in appsettings.json
Mentions adding .stylelintcache to .gitignore
References scss-and-partials.md

evals.prompt: Content editors on our freshly-upgraded v17 site say the rich text editor feels 'wrong' compared to v13 — no word count, images they upload end up dumped in the root of the Media section, and they can't add buttons in body copy any more, only plain links. What do I need to change?
evals.expected_output: Identifies these as RTE/TipTap data type config gaps after the move from TinyMCE to TipTap. For every Rich Text data type: enable Word Count (off by default in v17), set the Image Upload Folder to a top-level 'Uploads' media folder (create it if missing), and apply one standard toolbar layout rather than recreating the v13 TinyMCE toolbar. For buttons: register the Link Picker prop for TipTap from the v17 starter template or reference project. Also mentions setting the max inserted image size to 1280. Points to rte-config.md.
expectations: States Word Count must be enabled per Rich Text data type because it is off by default in v17
States the Image Upload Folder should be set to a top-level 'Uploads' media folder (creating it if needed)
Identifies the missing buttons as needing the Link Picker prop for TipTap, taken from the v17 starter template or reference project
Recommends applying one standard toolbar layout rather than recreating the v13 TinyMCE toolbar one-for-one
References rte-config.md
